children: Alcoa to acquire South32’s aluminium value chain assets in a proposed deal implying up to US$5.6 billion enterprise value.
Alcoa and South32 entered an Umbrella Implementation Deed for sale of bauxite, alumina and aluminium assets; shareholders vote at South32 AGM.
Consideration structure: US$3.1B upfront cash, ~US$1.0B in Alcoa shares/CDIs (17,008,960 units) and up to US$750M contingent price‑linked cash.
Alcoa to assume ~US$750M net debt/lease liabilities and ~US$1.1B of rehabilitation provisions related to the Sale Business.
Transaction would reposition South32 as a base‑metals focused company and is expected to boost remaining business copper‑equivalent production ~55%.
South32 Board unanimously recommends the Disposal Resolution; Independent Expert found the deal fair and reasonable absent a superior proposal.

title: Alcoa to Buy South32 Aluminium Assets in Deal Valued up to US$5.6B; US$3.1B Cash + US$1B Stock
